This includes $437.7 MILLION for MCAS Beaufort and Parris Island, and $507.1 MILLION for Joint Base Charleston through authorizations in the National Defense Authorization Act.

We reintroduced legislation to protect the Marine Corps Recruit Depot at Parris Island.

The Parris Island Protection Act blocks federal funds from being used to close or realign the depot and ensures it continues its mission of "Making Marines."

Millions of Marines have started their journey here. We will fight to make sure it remains the place where their journey begins for generations to come.

God bless the Lowcountry and God bless our Marines.
